bio: If you are looking for excellence and elegance, you are in the right place at Le Restaurant or Le Relais of the venerable Badrutt's Palace! In an atmosphere of luxury, the attentive front-of-house team provides classic service. The flavourful cuisine is made from exclusive ingredients and the menu also features a number of dishes that are prepared at your table, e.g. flambées, tartar etc. Whatever you opt for, there is a first-class selection of wines from the best vineyards to accompany your meal. Tip: You can also have breakfast here - accompanied by views of the lake and mountains....
